rationale: B keeps each animal's name and comment together in one table of structs, which is more cohesive than A's two parallel slices. B's verse logic is also easier to follow: an optional comment, then the chain, then the closing fly line, all under one 'not the last verse' check. A reuses comments[0] both as the fly's comment and as the closing line. It then needs the subtle guard v > 1 && v < len(animals) so the line is not emitted twice in verse 1, which makes the flow harder to reason about. A has small advantages: it uses len(animals) where B hardcodes 8, and it builds the spider suffix more concisely. B's clearer data model and control flow outweigh these.
